description: The 1.8i petrol K-Series is one of the most widely documented head gasket failure patterns in the entire Rover/Land Rover engine range — multiple manufacturer TSBs and specialist sources confirm it. We replace the head gasket and inspect the block as standard on every K-Series rebuild. The BMW-sourced M47 diesel fitted to both Freelander generations shares the same timing-chain stretch and injector-seal pattern found on contemporary BMW 3 Series and 5 Series diesels of the same era.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: Rover K-Series injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: Rover K-Series widely documented with multiple TSBs; the wear pattern is well established and something our Land Rover specialists repair regularly.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
